title: Topic 9
japanese_text:
A：この<u>武将</u>、<u>荒っぽい</u>性格で有名だけど、実は部下の家族のことを<u>思いやる</u>優しい<u>側面</u>もあったらしいよ。
B：へえ！ 誰にも<u>隙</u>を見せられないだろうから、優しさよりも厳しさが勝っていたんだろうね。
A：最後は味方に<u>欺かれて</u>死んでしまったし、切ないよね。だからこそ、彼の人気は今でも<u>健在な</u>のかもしれないけど。
english_translation: A: That military commander was famous for his coarse personality, but I've heard he actually had a gentle side and he cared for the families of his men. B: Heh! He could never let anyone see that vulnerability, so I suppose his harshness prevailed over his gentleness. A: In the end, he was deceived by his allies and died. It's sad. Maybe that's why his popularity is still going strong, though.
